risk_note: RV2 money change (withdraw lane, model Claude Fable 5.1; orchestrator rulings D10-181 ①, D10-456 ④ and D10-459): the paid withdrawal (W5 payout-landing, W11 withdrawal-proven-success) is added to app.tax_ytd on the same transaction, per the member's verified real-name identity (08 BR-WDR-20; BR-ID-25 细则「实名更正」). Money paths: amount_fen → cum_income_fen and tax_fen → cum_withheld_fen through @couli/money (bigint, ≥ 0), year = the +08:00 calendar year of created_at (@couli/domain accountingDate), one INSERT … ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT tax_ytd_identity_key DO UPDATE (infra/tax-ytd-store.ts). A member without a verified real name makes the landing / write-off roll back (warn tax_ytd_identity_missing, ids only). Rejections, failures and redelivered landings add nothing (the CAS guards the single add). identity's port realname-identity-key.ts was written by this lane for identity's review (D10-459). No frozen test changed; no contract change. Orchestrator 10-31 12:4x: a paid withdrawal whose member has no verified real name makes the landing / write-off roll back. (1) Precondition: an application needs realname_verified at both passes (withdraw-rules 30304); a verified app.realname row is never overwritten by a failed verification (realname.ts WHERE status <> 'verified'), a customer-service correction keeps status verified and only changes id_no_hmac (the new tax_ytd row is the intended design), and account deletion clears the row only at processing, which cannot start with a withdrawal in flight (deletion request refused 30412; cooling / processing refuses every non-GET login / realname route incl. POST /v1/withdrawals with 10007). (2) If it ever triggers: the landing job throws → pg-boss retries 5 times (10s → 600s backoff) → payout-landing.dead, the dead letter scan logs an error every 5 minutes (B1-01zzg), every attempt warns tax_ytd_identity_missing (ids only); the withdrawal stays PAYING without voucher or event; the query chain's manualDue sets needs_manual and warns payout_needs_manual (BR-WDR-14) → W10 manual handling; the landing job never pays, so no duplicate payout. W11: the write-off request fails and rolls back, the withdrawal stays APPROVED on hold, retryable; W11 pays nothing.
